title: Institutional AI: Governing LLM Collusion in Multi-Agent Cournot Markets via Public Governance Graphs
reasoning: The paper presents an experimental framework to evaluate a governance system for preventing economic collusion among LLM agents. While it addresses 'socially harmful' outcomes, its evaluation is based on economic market-structure metrics (HHI, CV) and mechanism design rather than benchmarking religion, morals, or specific ethical frameworks.
